chunks: And fold your hand to your wing/arm, it will come out white without blemish, another sign.

key_terms.جَنَاحِكَ: your wing or arm (referring to the armpit area)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the hand becoming white in Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this physical miracle (ayah) is often interpreted as a manifestation of divine light (nur) that remained pure from any physical defect, symbolizing the clarity of prophetic truth. It serves to validate Musa’s authority before Pharaoh and his people, reinforcing the concept of divine support through tangible signs.
